text:
Situation: Esomeprazole sodium inventory provides 25 days on hand at Corvale East and 29 days at Corvale General. Corvale East holds 132 units of the 20 mg/5 mL presentation (16.4 days) and 311 units of the 40 mg/5 mL presentation (32.7 days). Corvale General holds 242.16 units (25.6 days) and 308.43 units (31.6 days). Daily use is 17.6 units at East and 19.2 units at General.

Why (FDA record): As of 2026-10-21, esomeprazole sodium is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list. One label (NDC 68083045110) identifies Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) with a last inspection classification of VAI on 2024-07-25. A second label (NDC 70436019082) identifies Hainan Poly Pharm. Co., Ltd. (FEI 3005115952) with a last inspection classification of VAI on 2023-06-30. Both plants show only VAI classifications in available records, with no OAI or NAI findings.

Our position: Current stock covers roughly one month at both sites. No FDA shortage posting exists. Supply continuity depends on two manufacturers with VAI histories only.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchasing from Eugia US LLC and confirm manufacturing site transparency; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report any new posting; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to request updated allocation and lead-time data from current distributors for both presentations; requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
